evidence.context: Library was prepared using a poly-A pull-down and Illumina TruSeq RNA kit, and sequenced using Illumina HiSeq2000. Sequencing data are available online through GEO accession # GSE106420 (URL: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE106420 and Reviewer Token: ezghmqcqrbkzpkb). Analysis was done using R programming language package DeSeq2.( 19 ) For multidimensional scaling analysis we used the cmdscale and dist functions in R. For heatmaps, Z-score of rlog-normalized values were plotted using pheatmap .
